name: Timeline Editor
intro: Timeline Editor is a multi track video editor in your browser, with a media pool, trim tools, AI helpers and export, all in one place.

features.project-manager: The Project Manager is your starting point. Create a new project, give it a name, and each edit stays neatly separate.
features.import-media-files: The import button in the media pool brings in your clips, music and voice-overs, ready to drag onto the timeline.
features.edit-tab-media-pool-and-viewers: The Edit tab pairs a source viewer for a single clip with a timeline viewer that plays your whole edit as you build it.
features.tool-sidebar-and-shortcuts: The tool sidebar holds the Selection tool, Blade, Ripple Trim and more, each with its own keyboard shortcut for fast cutting.
features.tracks: Tracks let you layer b-roll, music and voice. Each track can be locked, muted or soloed, and you can add more at any time.
features.clip-properties-panel: Select a clip and the properties panel opens, with controls for transform, effects, transitions, captions and fades.
features.fill-gap: Fill Gap uses AI to bridge a gap between two clips, from a prompt you write, so you can smooth a jump cut.
features.export-tab: The Export tab sets your preset, frame rate and aspect ratio, then renders the final MP4.

outro: That's Timeline Editor. Import, cut, polish and export, with AI close at hand whenever the edit needs a little help.
